Third-party files served by GEAMS itself so the apps need no outside host to load:
  leaflet/      Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause), https://leafletjs.com
  face/         face-api.js 0.22.2 (MIT) and three model files from @vladmandic/face-api (MIT)
  fonts/        Exo 2 and Share Tech Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1), via @fontsource
Map pictures (tiles), place search and road routing are still online services unless you set GEAMS_TILE_URL,
GEAMS_ROUTE_URL and GEAMS_GEOCODE_URL to your own servers.

Security check (npm audit and registry, 6 Nov 2026):
  Leaflet 1.9.4 is the newest 1.x release and has no published advisories.
  face-api.js 0.22.2 is the newest release but is no longer maintained. It bundles TensorFlow.js 1.7.0, for which npm reports a
  node-fetch advisory. That code runs only in Node.js; GEAMS uses the browser build, where the browser's own fetch is used, so
  the advisory does not apply here. Re-check before launch and every few months. Planned: replace with a maintained library.
  CHECKSUMS.txt lists the SHA-256 of every third-party file; tests/t_vendor.js verifies them.
